sqlQueries.queryOriginal: Select Substr(ecfs,1,3) As cCaixas, sum(Valos) As Valos  From crCaixa ; 	       Where Emps = pcForm.Pagina.Dados.PageFrame1.Page1.Get_emps.Value ; 	             And Datas = pcForm.Pagina.Dados.PageFrame1.Page1.Get_datas.Value ; 	             And Substr(ecfs,1,3) = crSigFiMpi.nCaixa ; 	       Group By 1 Into Cursor crTotCaixa ReadWrite
